description: Reads the app's media, kept in collections apart from its code files: collections (with space used), list (items in order with card, URLs and variants), get, holders (who has the right to a private file), download_link (a temporary link for the developer). Changing them: neblla_media. More: neblla_get_llms tools/media_read

action.description: What to read. By action: list {collection, offset?, limit?}; get {id}; holders {id}; download_link {id}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

collection.description: list: the collection, by name or key.

offset.description: list: how many items to skip.

name: neblla_media_read
title: Read media
